acceptedAnswer.text: For saltwater pool construction in cities like Glendale or Pasadena, several permits are typically required. These commonly include a building permit for the pool structure itself, electrical permits for the pump, lighting, and salt chlorine generator, and sometimes plumbing permits. Depending on the scope, grading permits or permits for fencing/barriers might also be necessary.
